title: Sales Ai Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder Role Overview: You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows;
you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own "inboxes" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA. Key Responsibilities: - Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to "vet" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
- Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.
- Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a "Sales Knowledge Base" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.
- CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents "write back" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention. Qualifications: - Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.
- AI Tooling: Experience with "Agent-as-a-Service" platforms (e.G., 11x, Regie.Ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.
- Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.
- Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and "reasoning loops" to improve meeting-set rates.

Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. title: Cientista De Dados
description: A Dadoteca é uma empresa inovadora no setor de tecnologia, dedicada a fornecer soluções de alta qualidade para nossos clientes por meio de um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo que impulsiona o desenvolvimento profissional e a inovação. Atividades Projetar e implementar modelos de OCR utilizando frameworks e bibliotecas avançadas para extração de dados de documentos estruturados e não estruturados. Analisar, preparar e pré-processar grandes volumes de dados textuais, numéricos e, quando aplicável, espectrais, para uso em modelos de machine learning e deep learning. Desenvolver pipelines completos de processamento de dados, incluindo extração, transformação, armazenamento e disponibilização dos resultados de OCR. Integrar soluções de OCR com outras ferramentas e sistemas, automatizando fluxos de trabalho e processos de análise de dados. Realizar treinamentos, ajustes finos e manutenção de modelos de OCR para melhorar a acurácia em diferentes idiomas, fontes, formatos e níveis de ruído. Explorar e aplicar técnicas de Processamento de Linguagem Natural (PNL) para enriquecer a análise, categorização e organização dos textos extraídos. Aplicar técnicas de Quimiometria e análise multivariada (PCA, PLS, regressão multivariada e métodos de classificação) para modelagem, interpretação de dados complexos e apoio à tomada de decisão. Desenvolver modelos preditivos combinando dados textuais, numéricos e químicos/sensoriais, quando aplicável. Atualizar modelos quimiométricos para previsão de targets químicos (ex.: Nicotina, Açúcar) e sensoriais (Impact, Amount, Ripeness, Quality, Irritation e taste wheel), incluindo aplicações em SWIR. Garantir a qualidade analítica dos resultados gerados pelas plataformas analíticas por meio da gestão de indicadores, revisão de resultados e manutenção contínua dos modelos. Verificar a acurácia dos resultados apresentados em dashboards e ferramentas digitais utilizadas pelas plataformas analíticas. Apoiar o desenvolvimento de modelos de regressão utilizando técnicas quimiométricas. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir a integração das soluções de OCR e Quimiometria em projetos maiores de análise de dados. Monitorar e melhorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, assegurando escalabilidade, robustez, confiabilidade e aderência a padrões de qualidade e segurança. Pesquisar continuamente novas tecnologias relacionadas a OCR, Inteligência Artificial e Quimiometria, mantendo-se atualizada(o) com as tendências do setor. Orientar tecnicamente colegas e apoiar equipes em projetos de alta complexidade. Requisitos Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística, Química, Engenharia Química ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ciência de Dados, IA ou Quimiometria é desejável. Experiência consolidada em projetos de ciência de dados, com foco em OCR, processamento de imagens e/ou análise multivariada. Conhecimento prático em Quimiometria, incluindo PCA, PLS, regressão multivariada, métodos de classificação e validação de modelos. Conhecimento avançado em frameworks de deep learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch ou Keras). Experiência com bibliotecas de OCR como Tesseract, Google Vision, AWS Textract, ABBYY FineReader ou similares. Habilidade com técnicas de pré-processamento de imagens (OpenCV ou PIL). Domínio de Python ou R para aplicações de ciência de dados e modelagem estatística. Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais. Experiência com Git e práticas de MLOps. Inglês Fluente. Competências Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio complexos em soluções analíticas eficientes. Liderança técnica e orientação de equipes em projetos de alta complexidade. Compromisso com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade e impacto mensurável. Comunicação clara de insights técnicos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Proatividade para propor soluções inovadoras e superar desafios técnicos. Diferenciais Experiência aplicada em Quimiometria com dados reais, incluindo interpretação de modelos e comunicação de resultados para áreas de negócio. Familiaridade com Google Vision AI, AWS Textract ou Azure Cognitive Services. Conhecimento avançado em PNL. Experiência com implantação de soluções de OCR e modelos quimiométricos em ambientes produtivos e escaláveis (Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud). Certificações como Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate ou Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer.

title: Analista De Governança De Ti Sênior
description:
Purpose of the Position The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years. Main Challenges and Assignments Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.Experience and Professional Qualifications Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.G., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).Systems architecture expertise: Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.G., telecom, data centers, financial systems).Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field;
MBA or executive education is a plus.Behavioral Skills Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results;
drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively;
brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others;
adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility;
leads by example.

title: Ai Enablement Engineer / Ai Platform Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing:Work in a fully remote environment.Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details:Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. title: Arquiteto Consultor De Dados
description: ARQUITETO CONSULTOR DE DADOS(Enterprise Architecture | Hybrid & Multi-Cloud)A Copel busca um Arquiteto Consultor de Dados de alto nível para liderar a modernização e a governança de um ecossistema complexo e distribuído. O desafio exige orquestrar uma arquitetura que integra o core no GCP com sistemas críticos em AWS, OCI (SAP S/4) e infraestruturas On-premises, garantindo uma transição fluida para modelos de Data Mesh/Data Fabric e Lakehouse, sempre sob os rigorosos padrões da Arquitetura Corporativa (TOGAF). Conhecimento e vivência na construção de Data Produtos. ESCOPO DE ATUAÇÃO E RESPONSABILIDADES:Design de Arquitetura Híbrida (On-premise & Cloud): Projetar e gerenciar a integração entre o legado físico e a nuvem, garantindo a integridade do dado.Governança e Modelos de Entrega: Implementar o paradigma de Data Mesh e modelos Hub-and-Spoke, provendo ambientes de Sandbox seguros e estruturas de consumo para produtos de dados.Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de saúde de infraestrutura e pipelines, garantindo visibilidade total sobre a operação.Modernização Real-Time (Stream): Implementar estratégias de ingestão em modalidade Stream e fluxos transacionais.Design de Soluções (As-Is e To-Be): Mapear o estado atual e projetar o roadmap futuro, documentando regras de negócio e pipelines.Gestão de Engenharia e Qualidade: Garantir a aplicação de modelos de Fato e Dimensão com rotinas de validação na infraestrutura.Gestão de Alta Performance: Atuar com foco em Metas e Resultados, realizando a gestão de prazos, recursos físicos e financeiros (FinOps).Definição de arquitetura de governança e virtualização de dados.Definição e implantação de ferramentas de aquisição, com construção completa de pipelines de ingestão de dados.Atuar como referência técnica, mentorando o time e disseminando conhecimento sobre as plataformas e tecnologias adotadas.Projetar e implementar soluções de dados ponta a ponta, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e segurança.Definir modelos de dados otimizados para custo e eficiência.Estabelecer modelo de orquestração e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) em ambientes batch e streaming. PERFIL E REQUISITOS:Formação Acadêmica: Sólida formação em Engenharia de Software, Computação ou Ciência da Computação ou cursos correlatos com especialização em Dados.Idiomas: Habilidade avançada com a língua inglesa (leitura, escrita e conversação).Comunicação Interpessoal: Habilidade para influenciar stakeholders executivos e orientar times técnicos.Domínio de Ambientes Híbridos: Experiência comprovada na integração de ambientes On-premises com soluções Cloud.Frameworks e Metodologias: Conhecimento sólido em TOGAF e experiência com modelos Hub-and-Spoke/Sandbox.Especialista em Cloud (GCP): Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer e AlloyDB.Multi-Cloud e Bancos de Dados: Vivência com AWS, OCI e Bancos Oracle CDB/PDB, MongoDB e AlloyDB, CloudSQl, BigTable. DIFERENCIAIS:Certificações Cloud: Certificações oficiais Google Cloud (GCP Professional Data Engineer).Tecnologias Emergentes: Experiência com Denodo e uso de IA para aceleração de desenvolvimento de atividades de engenharia de dados.Desejável experiência na ferramenta Denodo.Participação na estruturação de processos. Buscamos um arquiteto que una o rigor acadêmico com a vivência prática de mercado. Este profissional será o maestro da integração tecnológica da Copel, garantindo que a inovação aconteça com segurança, transparência e alta disponibilidade técnica.

title: Assessor(A) De Vendas - Decoração
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesApoiar o acompanhamento do painel de vendas, contribuindo para a organização e atualização das informações comerciais do shopping;

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - OptimisationJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Product Manager - Mode (Remote)
description:
About Mode Mobile

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc., turning users into earners and, eventually, owners through stock ownership based on usage. The company has facilitated over $150M in earnings and savings for more than 40 million users across 170 countries.

Team & Culture

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster open communication and transparency. Our culture is driven by OKRs, positive intent, ownership, and a commitment to high standards.

For more details on how we work, you can read further at our internal resources.

The Role

Mode Mobile is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for a recently acquired multimillion‑dollar utility app. Over time, the role will expand to encompass newly acquired and organically developed mobile applications. This senior‑level, high‑ownership role requires a proven product leader with business acumen, operational excellence, and user empathy.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and lead a vision for your products that aligns with organizational goals
  • Develop strategic product‑feature roadmaps and drive execution from concept to scale by analyzing and implementing best‑in‑market trends and out‑of‑the‑box ideas
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, User Acquisition, Monetization, and Data teams to deliver value‑driven, measurable results
  • Own business and product performance, including revenue, engagement, conversion, retention, and P&L outcomes, and financial forecasts
  • Conduct ongoing experimentation, user and competitor research to support strategic decision making that drives monetization and user growth
  • Provide visibility into business performance and communicate results clearly to executive stakeholders and the broader organization
  • Serve as a role model and standard‑setter for product excellence for your cross‑function team
Who You Are
  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business
  • Expert at balancing user value with business impact, ensuring that both scale together
  • Skilled at using data, A/B experimentation, and intuition to make the best possible decisions
  • A natural collaborator who communicates effectively across all levels of the organization
  • Alignment with our core values
  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness, and consistently follow through on commitments
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact
  • Caring: Genuinely care about people, the business, and the mission, and strive to create a positive, supportive environment
  • Curious: Focus on the "why," learn, expand knowledge, explore new ideas, and continually improve
  • Thorough: Deliver thoughtful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous attention to detail
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of professional product management experience, including 3+ years of independently owning a product or business line
  • Proven experience managing products with P&L accountability and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Experience in mobile app ecosystems, with strong understanding of subscription, IAP, and IAA monetization strategies (utility, rewarded, social, or gaming apps is a plus)
  • Demonstrated success within multi‑app portfolios
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data tools such as Mixpanel, Google Sheets, and business performance dashboards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of influencing at the executive level
Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to guide us
  • Assume positive intent
  • Agree to disagree & commit
  • Set new precedents
  • Accomplish more with less
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards
  • Speak up
  • Be resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 rule
What We Are Offering
  • 100% remote‑first, global company
  • A competitive compensation package
  • Generous perks & benefits
  • Participation in the company equity and token plan (full‑time)
  • Individual bonuses in accordance with our bonus program
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people
  • Celebrate personal & work milestones
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies
  • Recognition via Bonusly
  • Weekly Wednesday "Get Stuff Done Days" (no meetings)
  • Open PTO and generous company holidays
  • 10 annual Wellness Fridays
Next Steps

If we just described the role you want and your ideal team, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to creating success together!

Equal Employment Opportunity

Mode Mobile does not accept or pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third‑party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
Head of Commercial Partnerships

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (”FWWC”).

The Head of Commercial Partnerships has responsibility, under the leadership of FIFA’s Director Commercial Partnerships and the operational guidance of the Brazil Entity Chief Operations Officers, for the successful implementation and coordination of the commercial revenue programs for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

This cross-functional position plays a critical role in planning, managing and implementing Host Country commercial revenues activities related to sponsorship sales, partnership management & partner rights delivery and commercial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • In close cooperation with FIFA’s Commercial Partnerships department, manage the day-to-day implementation plans in relation to the Tournament’s commercial partnerships programs, as well as manage relevant local sales agencies and service providers.
  • Working with Relevant Department Heads from FIFA, lead the Host Country commercial partnerships staff across sponsorship sales, partnership management and partner rights delivery.
  • Work with FIFA Commercial Partnerships Sub-Division and Host Country to shape integrated plans and strategies, including relevant sales and operational plans.
  • Working closely with the FIFA Partnership Sales team, ensure the effective delivery of the Tournament’s sponsorship sales with a focus on regional sponsorships in host country.
  • Identify and develop strong relationships with potential key sponsors and agencies in the host country and wider region, proactively lead on contract negotiations, and contribute to maintaining strong and effective relationships with sponsors.
  • Manage the regional sponsorship sales process in accordance with the defined timetable and priorities and negotiate agreements across relevant markets.
  • In close alignment with FIFA Partnership Management team, contribute to building strong and successful relationships with FIFA partners.
  • Working closely with FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and with the support of a local team, deliver all commercial operations as per the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • In close collaboration with the FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and Brazil, ensure successful implementation of the public Food & Beverage (F&B) concessions programme across all stadiums.
  • Manage and support a talented team of individuals, located at Brazil HQ across all commercial partnerships and licensing projects.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 10+ years of international commercial experience in sport
  • Proven experience within global sports / Rights Holder environment
  • Proven track record managing major commercial programs across sponsorship sales, partnership management and commercial operations
  • Proven and successful track record in opening, negotiating and closing significant multi-year, multi-million sponsorship deals
  • Knowledge of commercial operations in major event settings and/or the sports industry
  • Experienced negotiator and ability to manage complex and lengthy processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and at varying levels
  • Experience and knowledge of local markets and culture
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain qualified employees
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement
  • Creative and strategic thinker from a diverse background
  • Proficient in preparing and managing budgets
  • Proven organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly under pressure
  • Solid operational and strategic marketing knowledge/experience
  • Operational knowledge and experience in major international events, preferably sports events
  • Passion for sport

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

SOBRE NÓS!

Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome “Casas Guanabara”, o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.

Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.

E não para por aí!

A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.

Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 15 anos pela pesquisa “Marcas dos Cariocas”, em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas" .

E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 14 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

Já imaginou fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, que segue tendência mundial no setor de supermercados e conta com muitos talentos?

Se a sua resposta for sim, aqui é o seu lugar!

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us! Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities Executive Strategy & Leadership Support
  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.
  • Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of school‑wide strategic initiatives and long‑range goals.
  • Prepare executive‑level briefings, analyses, and recommendations to support informed decision‑making.
Institutional Coordination & Governance
  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.
Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)
  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.
Communications & Special Projects
  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment
  • Executive‑level written and verbal communication
  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred or Minimum 5 years of progressively responsible and relevant work experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in executive‑level administration, strategic planning, or institutional leadership.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast‑paced academic environments.

Descrição da vaga

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão?

Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira .

Se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você !

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula — onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas — até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará — com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas — as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros:

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;

title: Coordenador (a) de Transporte
description:
A Clubbi é um marketplace B2B para pequenos mercados de bairro. Fornecemos uma nova forma de abastecer a loja: mais conveniente, aos melhores preços e com os melhores prazos de entrega.

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures.

Em 2022, recebemos a rodada Series A, liderada por Hi Ventures e Nfx.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;
  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;
  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;
  • Temos foco e somos obcecados por priorização e eficiência;
  • Tratamos adultos como adultos, com autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Somos transparentes e não-hierárquicos;
  • Nos preocupamos genuinamente com as nossas pessoas;
  • Cuidamos para que a Clubbi seja um local incrível para trabalhar.
  • Acreditamos que um ambiente de excelência, aprendizado rápido, foco obsessivo no cliente junto com muita colaboração e diversão permite a todos alcançar o seu potencial pleno e contribuir com nossa missão.
Missão do Cargo

Num contexto de forte crescimento das vendas, gerenciar nossa frota agregada, assegurando profissionalismo, eficiência e disponibilidade dos motoristas.

A área de transporte tem um papel essencial dentro da Clubbi, impactando a experiência dos nossos clientes no momento da entrega, e garantindo nosso crescimento por meio da captação e desenvolvimento de novos motoristas.

A área de transporte também é responsável pelo transporte first mile, dos nossos fornecedores até o nosso armazém.

Principais Responsabilidades Gestão de transportadores (First Mile)
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar transportadores responsáveis pelas coletas e transferências iniciais da operação.
  • Garantir cumprimento de prazos, qualidade do serviço e aderência aos padrões operacionais.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e implementar melhorias na operação.
  • Procurar soluções de redução de custo nas coletas
✈️ Gestão da frota agregada
  • Gerenciar uma frota de aproximadamente 60 motoristas agregados.
  • Acompanhar desempenho operacional, pontualidade e qualidade das entregas.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com os motoristas para garantir engajamento e retenção.
  • Em colaboração com nossa área de Customer Experience & Tracking, garantir o bom andamento das entregas
Captação e treinamento de motoristas
  • Em colaboração com a área de planejamento, identificar necessidade de captação e adequação da nossa frota
  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento e integração de novos motoristas conforme o crescimento da empresa.
  • Organizar treinamentos operacionais e garantir o alinhamento às práticas e processos da empresa.
Gestão administrativa da operação
  • Validar e acompanhar pagamentos aos motoristas e transportadores.
  • Gerenciar processos de devolução de mercadorias, analisando causas e propondo melhorias.

Ready to leverage your scientific expertise to contribute to the growth and visibility of a global leader in preclinical research?

QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the B2B communication and marketing strategy targeting pharma and biotech sponsors, positioning our services as key partners in analytical and clinical development for both branded and generic drugs on the Brazilian and international markets.

We are seeking a scientifically driven professional, eager to grow into a strategic role at the crossroads of marketing, scientific communication, and business development.

Reporting to the Marketing & Communication Director, Life Sciences, you will be the marketing and scientific lead for Brazil. You will work closely with the marketing, sales, and R&D teams, as well as with external partners (agencies, designers, freelancers).

Responsibilities
  • Develop and manage your area: define the marketing strategy with the Marketing Director, Managing Director Brazil, and Heads of Pharma and Cosmetics; plan, implement, and monitor marketing actions and performance.

  • Scientific communication: make complex data accessible to varied audiences (sales, clients, conferences).
  • Support the sales team: develop sales tools, training materials, and presentations.
  • Inbound marketing: manage web pages (PT/EN), write SEO‑optimized articles, produce newsletters and email campaigns, and contribute to lead generation.
  • Measure ROI: track campaign results and lead conversions with the sales team.
  • Event organization: coordinate participation in conferences and trade shows; build a network of KOLs and strategic partners.
Qualifications
  • MSc (or higher) in Life Sciences (Pharmacy, Biology, Biotechnology, Chemistry); PhD is a plus.
  • 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B marketing/communication within pharma, biotech, medtech, or CRO sectors.
  • Strong understanding of the drug development process and clinical research.
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese, and Spanish required.
  • Proficiency in content creation and B2B CRM tools; knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and regulatory awareness.
Desired Profile
  • Autonomous and proactive, capable of driving a market segment.
  • Rigorous and results‑oriented, with strong organizational skills.
  • Creative and forward‑thinking.
  • Curious about scientific and market trends.
  • A strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Motivated by innovation and growth in an international environment.

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e aplicações escaláveis em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

Diferenciais Desejáveis
  • Experiência com mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento em outras linguagens como Java, Node.js, Python ou Go, com interesse em atuar com C#.
  • Familiaridade com containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experiência em meios de pagamento.
  • Automação de dashboards e alertas via código (IaC para observabilidade).
